demonstrated_actions.name: Aptitude & Verbal Ability Practice
demonstrated_actions.description: Use indiabigs.com to work through section‑wise aptitude and verbal ability questions and full tests.

steps.what_to_do: Visit indiabigs.com and select the aptitude section.
steps.why_it_matters: Allows focused practice on logical and quantitative questions.
steps.evidence: "so for my aptitude I am using this website it is called indiabigs.com... you will even get complete aptitude test"

steps.what_to_do: Navigate to the verbal ability section on the same site.
steps.why_it_matters: Ensures balanced preparation across both aptitude categories.
steps.evidence: "for the verbal ability वह भी यहां पर बहुत अच्छे से कवर कर रही है"

demonstrated_actions.why: Provides structured practice for logical, quantitative, and verbal sections needed for placement exams.
demonstrated_actions.timing_frequency: Regular practice as per personal schedule

demonstrated_actions.name: Technical Subject Study
demonstrated_actions.description: Study DBMS, OOPS, CN, OS concepts using GeeksforGeeks and W3Schools, and take their quizzes.

steps.what_to_do: Open GeeksforGeeks and search for each technical subject (e.g., DBMS, OOPS).
steps.why_it_matters: Provides detailed explanations and examples for each topic.
steps.evidence: "this is so far the best website... सारे concepts बहुत easy way में, बहुत detailed way में explain करेंगे"

steps.what_to_do: Visit W3Schools, select the relevant subject section, read through basic to advanced topics, and attempt the quizzes.
steps.why_it_matters: Offers structured learning paths and quiz‑based reinforcement.
steps.evidence: "W3 schools... all the topics from basic to advanced are covered... W3 schools quiz type so you can practice even a lot better"

demonstrated_actions.why: These sites explain concepts in an easy, detailed way and provide practice quizzes to reinforce learning.
demonstrated_actions.timing_frequency: Follow syllabus order or personal study plan

demonstrated_actions.name: Coding Interview Question Practice
demonstrated_actions.description: Search Google for "top 50 most asked coding questions" and practice using the downloadable sheets.

steps.what_to_do: Open Google and type "top 50 most asked coding questions".
steps.why_it_matters: Finds curated lists that cover common interview topics.
steps.evidence: "if you want to prepare तो आप google पे search कर लेना top 50 most asked coding questions"

steps.what_to_do: Download a sheet, select a question, and code a solution, then test it.
steps.why_it_matters: Hands‑on coding reinforces concepts and improves execution speed.
steps.evidence: "you can pick any sheets और वहाँ ऐसे आप practice कर सकते हो"

demonstrated_actions.why: Repeatedly solving the most frequently asked problems builds problem‑solving speed and familiarity.
demonstrated_actions.timing_frequency: Practice daily or as needed before interviews

demonstrated_actions.name: English Speaking Practice for Interviews
demonstrated_actions.description: Spend at least five minutes each day speaking English, using common interview prompts and practicing in front of a mirror.

steps.what_to_do: Prepare a list of typical interview questions (e.g., "Introduce yourself", "Tell us about your background").
steps.evidence: "question like introduce your self, tell about your background"

steps.what_to_do: Set a timer for five minutes and answer each question aloud, focusing on clear pronunciation.
steps.evidence: "I am trying to speak for at least 5 minutes in English"

steps.what_to_do: Repeat the practice in front of a mirror to observe facial expressions and body language.
steps.evidence: "mirror में देखकर practice करना is so far the best technique for the interviews"

demonstrated_actions.why: Improves fluency, reduces confidence loss, and prepares for typical interview questions.
